content: In this work, the notion of “word importance” is employed to quantify the contribution that a word in the input sentence makes to the NMT generations. We categorize the methods of word importance estimation into two types: black-box methods without the knowledge of the model and white-box methods that have access to the model internal information (e.g., parameters and gradients). Previous studies mostly fall into the former type, and in this study, we investigate several representative black-box methods:
